headlines.title: Paychex (PAYX) Launches AI HR Tool And Confirms Dividend, Is It Still Below Fair Value?
headlines.summary: Paychex (PAYX) has been in focus after its board confirmed a regular quarterly dividend of $1.19 per share and affiliate SixFifty launched an AI driven HR compliance specialist for employers. Recent moves suggest interest in Paychex is picking up again, with a 1-day share price return of 2.22% and a 7-day gain of 6.05%. This contrasts with a weaker 30-day share price return that declined 6.36% and a 1-year total shareholder return that fell 8.56%.

headlines.title: Paychex (PAYX) Stock Could Be 40% Undervalued As AI Compliance Tool Launches
headlines.summary: Paychex has had a mixed run on the market over the past year, and the real question for investors now is whether the current share price lines up with what its cash flows can reasonably support. With fresh product news in HR technology and a solid history in payroll services, the stock invites a closer look at how much cash the underlying business is set up to generate. The share price has declined 8.

headlines.title: Paychex (PAYX) Unveils First Agentic HR Compliance Specialist
headlines.summary: Paychex (NasdaqGS:PAYX) subsidiary SixFifty has launched an AI-powered agentic HR compliance specialist for employers. The new tool automates complex employment law compliance tasks across multiple jurisdictions for small and mid-sized businesses. SixFifty’s system can draft and distribute HR policies and track employee acknowledgments within a single workflow. There is much more to Paychex than the new SixFifty AI HR compliance specialist launch described here.

headlines.title: Paychex AGM Highlights AI Growth Strategy, Stock Split Debate and Shareholder Votes
headlines.summary: Paychex (NASDAQ:PAYX) held its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders virtually on Oct. 15, with shareholders voting on director elections, executive compensation, auditor ratification and a shareholder proposal related to special meetings.

headlines.title: Paychex Declares Quarterly Dividend
headlines.summary: ROCHESTER, N.Y., Oct. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Board of Directors of Paychex, Inc. (Nasdaq: PAYX) declared a regular quarterly cash dividend on Paychex common stock of $1.19 per share, payable on November 25, 2026, to shareholders of record as of October 26, 2026. About Paychex Paychex, Inc. (Nasdaq: PAYX) provides a comprehensive suite of expert-enabled technology and advisory solutions that help businesses manage HR, payroll, and benefits.

description: Paychex, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides human capital management solutions (HCM) for human resources, payroll processing, employee benefits, and insurance services for small to medium-sized businesses in the United States, Europe, Canada, India, and Israel. It offers technology and advisory solutions; and payroll tax administration services. The company also provides retirement solutions, such as plan implementation, ongoing compliance with government regulations, employee and employer reporting, participant and employer online access, electronic funds transfer, and other administrative services; HCM solutions from recruiting and hiring to retirement; and talent management and talent acquisition services. In addition, it offers payroll solutions, including calculation, preparation, and delivery of employee payroll checks; production of internal accounting records and management reports; preparation of federal, state, and local payroll tax returns; and collection and remittance of clients' payroll obligations. Further, the company provides workforce management solutions; benefits administration solutions; digital marketplace for earned wages, financial wellness solutions, and voluntary lifestyle benefits; administrative services organization HR outsourcing solutions; solutions to payroll and non-payroll customers; retirement and funding solutions; and insurance services for property and casualty coverage, such as workers' compensation, business-owner policies, cyber security protection, and commercial auto, as well as health and benefits coverage, including health, dental, vision, and life. Additionally, it offers payroll, HR, employee benefits administration, retirement, insurance, risk management outsourcing, and access to professionally trained HR representatives, virtually and on-site. It markets and sells its solutions primarily through its direct sales force. Paychex, Inc. was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Rochester, New York.
